## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ProxyBallerinaCentralWithAMa`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `proxy-ballerina-central-with-maven-repos`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ProxyBallerinaCentralWithAMa**.

## Step 2: Configure Sonatype Nexus

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your Nexus Repository Manager as an administrator. -->
2. <!-- manual: Navigate to Settings → Repository → Repositories and click Create repository. -->
3. Select **maven2 (proxy)** as the recipe.
4. <!-- manual: Fill in the repository details. -->
5. <!-- manual: Under the Maven 2 section, ensure Strict Content Type Validation is disabled (unchecked). "Ballerina Central serves .bala package artifacts alongside customized Maven metadata, and enabling strict content type validation will cause downloads to fail for non-standard MIME types." -->
6. Under the **Proxy** section, set **Maximum metadata age** to a low value such as `1` minute. This ensures that newly published packages in Ballerina Central are discovered promptly without waiting for a long metadata cache expiry. > **Note:** Setting **Maximum metadata age** to `0` forces Nexus to re-fetch metadata on every request, which may increase latency. A value between `1` and `5` minutes is a good balance between freshness and performance.
7. Select **Create repository** to save the configuration.
8. <!-- manual: Copy the repository URL displayed on the repository list page. You will use it when configuring the Ballerina client. -->

## Step 3: Configure JFrog Artifactory

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your Artifactory instance as an administrator. -->
2. Select **Create a Repository**.
3. Select **Remote**.
4. Select **Maven** as the package type.
5. <!-- manual: Fill in the repository details. -->
6. <!-- manual: Under the Advanced tab, apply the following settings. -->
7. <!-- manual: Block Mismatching MIME Types — Ensure this is disabled. "Ballerina Central serves .bala artifacts that do not conform to standard Maven MIME types. Enabling this option will cause artifact retrieval to fail." -->
8. <!-- manual: Bypass HEAD Requests — Ensure this is enabled. "Ballerina Central does not fully support HTTP HEAD requests for all artifact paths." Enabling this bypass ensures that Artifactory falls back to a GET request when a HEAD request fails, preventing resolution errors. -->
9. <!-- manual: Metadata Retrieval Cache Period — Set this to a low value such as 60 seconds. This controls how long Artifactory caches repository metadata before re-fetching it from the remote. A lower value ensures that newly published packages in Ballerina Central become available in your proxy repository sooner. -->
10. Select **Save & Finish** to create the repository.
11. <!-- manual: Copy the repository URL from the Artifacts view. You will use it when configuring the Ballerina client. -->
